purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Truck Order Generation Truck Order Summary details.
features: This feature allows the user to generate Truck Order Summary for the selected bookings.

events.description: Generates the Truck Order Summary for the selected bookings.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more bookings using the check boxes, clicks the ☰ icon next to Truck Order Generation and selects "Truck Order Summary".
